items.rationale: Glass Breakage Cover is agreed, so under 2.7.2 the glazing work includes the preparatory drilling for hardware. Case 11 shows a low price level for drilling, below 19.

items.description: Installation of new glass into frame
items.rationale: Setting, fitting and sealing is glazing work and is indemnified under 2.7.2 because the optional peril is agreed. Case 11 puts the price level below 41.
The cabinet pane is a glazing element and the optional peril is agreed, so the made-to-measure replacement is covered. Case 11 puts the price level below 68.
One attendance per undertaking is indemnified under 7.1.12 because indemnified glazing work was done at that visit. The reference cases show a small amount, under 20.
